name: no-ai-slop
description: Writing rules against AI-sounding prose and fabricated claims, with pattern catalogues for English and German.

ban_dashes.title: Ban dramatic dashes
ban_dashes.description: Forbid em dashes and spaced en dashes as sentence breaks. Turn off if your style guide allows them.

max_sentence_words.title: Sentence-length ceiling (words)
max_sentence_words.description: Upper limit for sentence length. A ceiling, not a target.
